description: The LOCALE phrase of the SPECIAL-NAMES ALPHABET clause (ALPHABET name [FOR ALPHANUMERIC|NATIONAL] IS LOCALE [locale-name-2]), ISO 12.3.7.2 - introduced 2002 with the locale facility (Annex A.4.9 item 10). The named form is the collating sequence of a SPECIAL-NAMES locale-name; the bare form is the locale current at each use (12.3.7.4 GR7e). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitAlphabetClause; LOCALE is a plain word below 2002 - a code-name there).
citation: ISO §2023:12.3.7.2 alphabet-name-clause (the LOCALE phrase, either branch); §2023:12.3.7.4 GR7e
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility; kb/Work PB101 - the collation engine and the ALPHABET LOCALE phrase)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB101AL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
OBJECT-COMPUTER. X PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS LOC.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    ALPHABET LOC IS LOCALE.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
